title: Eye in the Labyrinth
writer: Mario Caiano, Antonio Saguera, Horst Hächler
actors: Rosemary Dexter, Adolfo Celi, Horst Frank
plot: A woman searches for her missing lover, a psychiatrist who has suddenly vanished for no apparent reason. She ends up at a villa populated by a group of eccentric individuals. A string of murders commences immediately.
